scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('web-dist/index.html')) { console.error('Missing web-dist/index.html. Run npm run build:web from apps/api locally, then commit apps/api/web-dist before deploy.'); process.exit(1); } console.log('Using committed frontend dist from apps/api/web-dist');"
scripts.build:web: node -e "const {execSync}=require('node:child_process'); execSync('npm --workspace apps/web run build',{stdio:'inherit',cwd:'../..'});" && rm -rf web-dist && cp -R ../web/dist web-dist
